Content of the first podcast:
・Main topic: Criteria for choosing a good blockchain & crypto project.
・Detailed content: Advisor Do Manh Hung shares his initial challenges when entering the blockchain & crypto space in 2016, emphasizing the need for a set of criteria to evaluate blockchain & crypto projects to select truly strong and sustainable ones. The four key criteria are: What is the project's foundational technology? Is the development team strong? How is the project's media approach? Is the market potential of the project still good enough for investment?
